description: This file is a shell script that manages WiFi MAC address filtering by allowing, restoring, adding, deleting, flushing, and displaying MAC addresses in a MAC filter list. It interacts with external services via commands like psmcli and wifi_api, and includes usage instructions and helper functions.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: list_include_idx
methods.description: Checks if an index is included in a list.
